# Regreenity — Full Product Reference

Regreenity is a PlanetHike OÜ project for cruise-line passenger experience. It is designed as a white-label interaction layer inside the cruise line's existing app rather than as a separate consumer social network.

## Core product areas

### Passenger experience
- Opt-in discovery through coarse nearby context, shared activities or voluntarily shared interests.
- First contact uses predefined positive affirmations rather than unrestricted stranger messaging.
- A public onboard place or activity may be proposed only after the recipient acknowledges the first contact.
- Cabins, phone numbers and precise live distance are not exposed.

### Crew recognition
- Guests can recognize a crew member while the service moment is fresh.
- Recognition includes sailing context and selected reasons.
- The design emphasizes breadth, consistency and context rather than public crew rankings.
- Badge-photo identification may be used; facial recognition is not part of the design.

### Service recovery
- Guests receive a private route to signal friction during the sailing.
- The intended workflow is capture, routing, acknowledgement, resolution and follow-up.
- Experience Pulse can provide private department-level feedback and post-recovery measurement.

### Engagement and ancillary discovery
- Voluntary interests and onboard context can surface relevant activities or experiences.
- The cruise line retains inventory, pricing, checkout, payment and fulfilment.
- Commercial measurement should use an agreed attribution or treatment/control design.

## Architecture
- Device: cached interface, preferences and pending actions.
- Ship-local: host identity, approved proximity capabilities and onboard synchronization where available.
- Deferred cloud: analytics, replication and external sharing when connectivity is available.
- Native proximity and host-system integrations require cruise-line implementation.

## Product and evidence boundaries
- Regreenity is not a cruise operator, booking engine, merchant, unrestricted chat service or dating app.
- Public demonstrations and metrics are illustrative and do not imply a cruise-line affiliation.
- Offline-first operation is an architecture direction, not a claim of an existing production deployment.
- Performance claims should follow real pilot evidence.
